_comment: StarLadder Budapest Major 2025 — Stage 1 (Swiss). RESULTS fully reconciled and internally consistent (verified via /browse 2026-05-29; both anchors confirmed: exactly 8 teams at 1-1 entering R3; final eight = M80, FlyQuest, B8, Fnatic, NIP, PARIVISION, Imperial, FaZe). SEEDING IS UNRESOLVED — the authoritative Valve 1-16 seed assignment could not be sourced (HLTV Cloudflare-walled; Liquipedia/Wikipedia do not publish seed integers), and the observed R1/R2 pairings do NOT reduce to a seed-offset fold under the VRS world-rank order. The full pairing-reproduction backtest (GATE-01) is therefore DEFERRED — see .planning/todos/pending. This fixture freezes the VERIFIED results only; it is NOT asserted against engine pairing generation.

format.advancement_elimination: Bo3 (a match is Bo3 iff a team is at 2W or 2L)

provenance.cross_check: HLTV VRS world ranks supplied by user (screenshots 2026-05-29) — used for the seeding investigation only; HLTV event page is Cloudflare-walled
provenance.results_status: fully reconciled + internally consistent (8 advance / 8 eliminated; no rematch; legal record progression)
provenance.seeding_status: RESOLVED 2026-05-29 from the authoritative Valve open-source standings snapshot; full round-by-round backtest GREEN
provenance.seeding_source: ValveSoftware/counter-strike_regional_standings — invitation/2025/details/2025_11_03 (the Major seeding snapshot, captured after the final RMR). Each team is filed by its global VRS rank at that cutoff; the 16 Stage-1 teams sorted by that rank give the 1-16 seed order — verbatim, no hand-disambiguation. Validated: the engine reproduces every actual round-by-round pairing (R1-R5) under this order (test_backtest_budapest_2025). NOTE: an earlier pass hand-swapped four adjacent seeds (Fnatic/PARIVISION 5/6, RED Canids/The Huns 13/14); the backtest caught it at R2. The pure VRS-rank order is correct.

seeding_note: RESOLVED. The 1-16 Stage-1 seeds are the global-VRS-rank order from the timestamped Valve VRS snapshot used for Major seeding (ValveSoftware/counter-strike_regional_standings, 2025_11_03), NOT live HLTV/VRS — that was the original mistake (the 'snapshot rule'). The 16 Opening-Stage teams sorted by their global VRS rank in that snapshot give this order, verbatim. Validated end-to-end: the engine reproduces EVERY actual round-by-round pairing (R1-R5) under this seeding (test_backtest_budapest_2025), confirming the engine's pairing logic is correct (Hypothesis B). The earlier HLTV world-rank order (kept below for the record) was the wrong source.

seeding_validation.round1_kvsk8: 8/8 exact: seed k vs k+8 yields the 8 actual R1 matches (test_round1_is_kvsk8_under_resolved_seeds).
seeding_validation.round2_within_group_fold: EXACT: with the pure-VRS-rank seeds, both R2 8-team groups (1-0 High, 0-1 Low) fold to the actual pairings (positions (1,8),(2,7),(3,6),(4,5)) — the rulebook's 'highest faces lowest available'. (An earlier pass hand-swapped Fnatic/PARIVISION (5/6) and RED/The Huns (13/14), which made R2 appear to diverge; the backtest caught it. Pure VRS rank is correct.)
seeding_validation.rounds_3_4_5: EXACT: R3 (4/8/4-team groups) and R4/R5 (6-team groups, Valve's verbatim 15-row priority table, GATE-04) all reproduce. Full gate green.
seeding_validation.engine_logic_status: CONFIRMED sound end-to-end (Hypothesis B): the original divergence was wrong seed integers from the wrong source, not wrong pairing rules.

vrs_seeding_divergence_RESOLVED: RESOLVED 2026-05-29. The world-rank order above (live HLTV/VRS) did NOT reproduce the bracket because Valve seeds Majors off a timestamped VRS SNAPSHOT captured after the final RMR (the 'snapshot rule'), not live VRS. The authoritative snapshot (Valve open-source repo, 2025_11_03, global rank order) yields the seed order in the 'seeding' field, and the engine reproduces the FULL bracket (R1-R5) under it. The engine's pairing logic was correct all along (Hypothesis B); the divergence was wrong seed integers from the wrong source. GATE-01 is closed.
